properties.leader: Maghrawa, Zenata and other regional dynasties
properties.info: Around 1000, the western Maghreb was divided among several Berber dynasties and local powers, including the Maghrawa and Banu Ifran, with shifting Umayyad and Fatimid influence. It was not a unified Moroccan or Algerian kingdom. Modern regions are rough map references; the southernmost Saharan regions are omitted.
